faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Straight answers about what NexusContent is and is not.

items.question: Do I have to use Git for content?
items.answer: No. Git is one provider. This example wires pages and posts to Git JSON, but every model declares its own source - the same site can read WordPress or Strapi instead.

items.question: Does NexusContent edit or render my content?
items.answer: No. Editors stay in the CMS, and rendering stays in your application. NexusContent only retrieves, normalizes, and validates.

items.question: Is this tied to Astro?
items.answer: No. Astro is the reference consumer, but the core runs in plain Node too.

items.question: Can I mix providers on one site?
items.answer: Yes. Each model picks its source, so the homepage can come from Git while blog posts come from WordPress.

cta.heading: Want the same setup?
cta.body: From a two-provider reference consumer to a full content strategy, the shape is the same.
